title: Blue Teacher of Love Magic
description: A blue-skinned female teacher with dark hair in an updo stands in a magical classroom, wearing glasses, a black leather jacket over a white shirt, and dark pants. She holds a glowing pink smartphone in one hand while standing beside a wooden desk with books, a lit candle, and a red apple, in front of a green chalkboard covered in romantic diagrams and text about binding affection and common decency.
prompt: A blue-skinned female teacher with glasses and dark hair in an elaborate updo adorned with flowers stands confidently in a dimly lit magical classroom. She wears a black leather jacket with silver buttons over a white shirt, a scarf, and dark pants, holding a glowing pink smartphone. Next to her is a wooden desk with stacked books, a lit candle, and a shiny red apple. Behind her, a large green chalkboard displays Lesson 17: Binding Affection Without Chains, diagrams of hearts, and text about mutual pleasure, common decency, and love magic. The background features arched windows with glowing heart symbols, in a detailed digital painting style with atmospheric lighting.
